# Quartz

> Quartz is a business intelligence platform covering AI spending, macroeconomic policy, geopolitical risks, and technology sector developments.

Quartz delivers daily coverage of global business news with focus on emerging technologies, Federal Reserve policy, international trade dynamics, and corporate earnings. The site serves professionals seeking analysis of AI investment trends, tariff impacts, and market-moving financial developments.

## Key Topics

- AI spending
- Federal Reserve
- Tariffs
- Tech companies
- Oil markets
- Earnings reports
- Financial news
- Business news
- Jerome Powell
- Trump administration
- Geopolitics
- Corporate earnings
- Macroeconomics
- Technology sector
- Market analysis

## Business & Markets

- [Quartz](https://qz.com): Quartz homepage featuring business news on AI spending, tariffs, tech, Federal Reserve policy, and global markets
